reviews.t: Don't let the outside of the building fool you. It looks like a 1950's "curl & chat." There is some real hidden talent inside. Monica Gardner is amazing with hair. She does great cuts, but her talent really shines with color. She's so affordable it's almost absurd.

The stylist did a great job on my daughter's hair. It was a last minute appointment and we had called around several places. She was able to squeeze us in while some ones hair color was setting... We will be back
Monica has been my colorist/stylist for several years now. She's a genius!
Monica's awesome!! I found the one! xxoo I'm hair happy.
Great cuts are a ridiculously low price. Been a customer for 15 yrs. Ask for Monica or Theresa
Monica does my hair She is great.
Only place I will get my hair done! Love love love!!!
Got one of the best haircuts I’ve ever had they do men and women and children
